actual_assay_parameters: Unchanged exact archived CSV row in model_configuration.json, not the rounded paper vector.
holding_difference: For rounded prompt vector, uhold=-41.1551pA and Ihold=131.5472914pA. Exact archived CSV independently verified: uhold=-41.11566219369pA and Ihold=131.424091136629pA. GPU float32 realization recorded per sweep.
independence_limit: Later paper is independent of the 2018 fitting evidence; this does not establish model-independent biological equivalence.
